840	1:01:56	Under which screen are we speaking here?	De qual masach se trata aqui?
841	1:01:58	The screen of this Malchut, which has now made the reflected light in Atzilut,	O masach desta Maljut, que agora produziu a luz refletida em Atzilut,

844	1:02:13	is considered the Malchut of the guf.	é considerada a Maljut do guf.
